meta.name: gh-issues
meta.description: Use when a repository has GitHub issues, review requests, labels, milestones, or watch-mode triage that should be selected and handled with GitHub CLI access.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 筛选并处理 GitHub 仓库的 issue 和 PR
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要高效地筛选和分配 GitHub 仓库中的 issue 和 PR。
copy.tagline_en: Filter and handle GitHub repository issues and pull requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to efficiently triage and assign GitHub issues and pull requests.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能获取 GitHub issues，筛选并决定处理哪些，然后派后台 agent 去实施修复或处理审查评论。
howto.when: 当用户提到 GitHub issues、审查请求、标签、里程碑或监控模式时，或要求处理仓库的 issue 时触发。

say.text: 列出这个仓库打开的 issues
say.note: Claude 会显示紧凑的 issue 表格。
Claude 会确认后派 worker 去修复。

say.text: 设置 watch 模式每 5 分钟检查新 issue
say.note: Claude 会持续轮询并处理新内容。

howto.what_en: This skill fetches GitHub issues, filters pull requests, and spawns background agents to implement fixes or address review comments.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions GitHub issues, review requests, labels, milestones, or watch-mode triage, or when a repository has relevant items.

say_en.text: List open issues for this repo
say_en.note: Claude will show a compact issue table.
Claude will confirm and spawn a worker to fix it.
Claude will poll and process new issues.
